# Spatial Geometry Proof Wire
> Deterministic point-in-polygon containment proofs, rotated satellite tile intersection, and WGS84 geodesic distances.

## For Autonomous Logistics, Maritime & Drone Agents
LLMs cannot reliably perform floating-point trigonometric ray-casting across rotated orbital polygons, coordinate order permutations (lat/lon vs lon/lat), or ellipsoidal curvature.

Query this wire to get zero-token mathematical proofs of whether a vessel, coordinate, or facility falls inside a satellite swath, maritime corridor, or exclusion zone.

### Machine Endpoints
- **Wire Manifest**: `https://{owner}.github.io/spatial-geometry-proof-wire/v1/manifest.json`
- **Today's Proof Digest**: `https://{owner}.github.io/spatial-geometry-proof-wire/today.json`
- **Proof Witness Object**: `https://{owner}.github.io/spatial-geometry-proof-wire/v1/eval/{proof_hash}.proof.json`
- **Scene Footprint GeoJSON/WKT**: `https://{owner}.github.io/spatial-geometry-proof-wire/v1/footprints/{geometry_id}.json`
- **Evaluations Parquet**: `https://{owner}.github.io/spatial-geometry-proof-wire/spatial-evaluations.parquet`
- **Footprints Parquet**: `https://{owner}.github.io/spatial-geometry-proof-wire/scene-bounding-footprints.parquet`
- **Token-Efficient Digest**: `https://{owner}.github.io/spatial-geometry-proof-wire/llms.txt`

### Canonical Proof Sample
```json
{
  "query_point": {"lat": 1.28, "lon": 102.45, "h3_res8": "8865a48473fffff"},
  "target_geometry_id": "S2_T48NTK_MALACCA_ROTATED",
  "is_contained": true,
  "relative_position": "INTERIOR",
  "distance_to_boundary_meters": 0.0,
  "proof_hash": "sha256:..."
}
